fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. Avoid common passwords.

setup.title: Set up Cellhive
setup.description: Create the first administrator account and your organization.
setup.orgHint: You can invite your team once it is created.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to your Cellhive account.
login.forgotPasswordNoEmail: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator of your organization for a reset link.

notice.setupComplete: Your account and organization are ready. Sign in to continue.
notice.invitationAccepted: Your account is ready. Sign in to open the organization.
notice.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

ssoError.OIDC_STATE_INVALID: This sign-in expired or was already used. Try again.
ssoError.OIDC_PROVIDER_ERROR: The identity provider could not sign you in. Try again, or contact an administrator if it keeps happening.
ssoError.OIDC_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password, then connect the provider under "Connected accounts" in your account menu.
ssoError.OIDC_SIGNUP_DISABLED: No Cellhive account is connected to this sign-in. Contact an administrator to be invited.
ssoError.OIDC_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your identity provider did not confirm your email address, so no account can be created. Confirm it with the provider, or contact an administrator.
ssoError.OIDC_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Accounts cannot be created for this email domain. Contact an administrator to be invited.
ssoError.accountDisabled: Your account has been disabled. Contact an administrator.
ssoError.RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
ssoError.generic: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.noEmail: Email is not set up on this server. Ask an administrator of your organization for a password reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 24 hours.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After the change you are signed out everywhere.
reset.revokeTokensHint: Recommended if someone else may have used your account. Integrations, scripts and connections that use your tokens stop working until you create new ones.
reset.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
reset.invalidDescription: Request a new password reset link.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.description: You are invited to join {{org}} as {{role}}.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {{current}}, but this invitation is for {{invited}}. Sign out to continue.
invite.invalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.invalidDescription: The link is wrong, already used, revoked or expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
